mapper.select:
select STEEL_RING_CODE, listagg(sm.MACHINE_ID,',') within group (order by sm.MACHINE_ID) as machine_ids from T_GSQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by STEEL_RING_CODE

select SPEC, ORDER_WAY, regexp_replace(listagg(a.MACHINE_ID,',') within group (order by a.MACHINE_ID), '([^,]+)(,\1)+', '\1') as machine_ids from T_GSQ_TWINING_DISC a inner join T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO m on a.machine_id = m.id where a.DEL_FLAG = '0' and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by SPEC, ORDER_WAY

SELECT BEAD_CODE steelRingCode, max(DIMENSION || '~' ||BEAD_ARRANGE) specOrder FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO where (embryo_code,EMBRYO_VERSION) in (SELECT embryo_code,BOM_DATA_VERSION FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) group by BEAD_CODE
